meta.title: Jessica Tan - Transformation, Growth & Product Executive
meta.description: Jessica Tan is a C-level transformation and commercial executive who reshapes and scales products, commercial models and teams to accelerate profit across PE-backed and growth-stage businesses, and helps companies land AI transformation that delivers measurable commercial impact.

hero.headline: Strategy decides. Change delivers. I've owned both.
hero.intro: I work with CEOs and PE-backed, growth-stage companies to drive the product, process and people change where most programmes stall. Recently building an AI product hands-on, I help teams land transformation that shows up in the P&L.

items.title: AI transformation
items.body: Helping leadership teams land AI where it earns its keep, and steering CEOs through the people and process change that makes it stick.

items.title: Commercial growth and go-to-market
items.body: Clarifying where to play, strengthening propositions and pricing, and converting opportunity into measurable revenue.

items.title: Product and operating-model transformation
items.body: Connecting customer needs, commercial priorities and execution into products and operating models that create real enterprise value.
Revenue and synergies delivered through M&A and post-merger integration across three acquisitions, within three years.
Commercial strategy mobilised with 60+ cross-functional stakeholders, and across 11 European markets.
After-sales contract uptake grown by redesigning the customer journey, commercial proposition and delivery model.
Improvement in workforce utilisation through operational redesign and dispatch optimisation.

experience.heading: Experience
experience.intro: Twenty years in commercial and product leadership, the last fifteen focused on transformation, across energy, real-estate marketplaces, FMCG and climate-tech, in Germany, the UK, France and Australia, including PE-backed and scale-up environments.

venture.heading: Current venture
venture.bodySuffix: , an AI personality product, partnering with a professor at ESMT Berlin. Brand strategy through technical build, now in private beta. Available for senior interim, fractional and advisory mandates spanning transformation, commercial growth and portfolio value creation, with PE-backed and growth-stage companies.

contact.heading: Let's discuss what results you want.
contact.sub: For fractional leadership, advisory and selected consulting engagements.
